notes: Sides: just inside the straight thin rule that runs inside the thick bar, with points every 300-400 px where the frame bows (the four-corner outline sat 10-20 px inside the rule at mid-side and cut a hatched block on the right near y 1700), about 3 px inside the thin rule's inner edge measured on 8x crops. The ZONE MAP title/legend block (top left) floats over the map with no rule and stays inside (README rule 4).
